title: Presidents look into UFOs and find nothing

tellings.quote: And so every president that gets in there, you know, Clinton and Obama, Trump, you know, we're going to find out what's going on, right?

plain: Every new president, Clinton, Obama and Trump among them, arrives at the White House set on finding out what is really going on with UFOs, and finds nothing. That is the argument the skeptic Michael Shermer makes to Michels, without citing a source. His point is that if there were a hidden truth, a president who went looking would have found it.
